title: METHODS FOR TESTING TAR AND BITUMINOUS MATERIALS - Determination of specific gravity
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the methods for the determination of specific gravity of asphalt, bitumen, bituminous products, road tar, coal tar, coal tar pitch, creosote and anthracene oil.
clause_3_terminology: METHODS FOR TESTING TAR AND BITUMINOUS MATERIALS
METHODS FOR TESTING TAR AND BITUMINOUS MATERIALS - Determination of specific gravity

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
